title: Semantic Communication via Analog RF Computing: When the Radio Computes the Meaning
abstract: arXiv:2611.22100v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic communication (SC) systems transmit continuous latent representations of meaning, but computing the semantic encoder at resource-constrained edge devices incurs substantial energy and memory costs. To address this challenge, we propose an end-to-end SC framework that executes the semantic encoder in the client's RF receiver front end using analog RF computing. A base station (BS) broadcasts encoder weights as RF waveforms, while each edge device reuses its receiver's passive mixer to compute semantic latents at ultra-low energy. These latents are transmitted over the uplink for network-side task inference. We show that analog computing noise across encoder layers and channel noise affecting transmitted latents admit a unified mathematical model. translated_title: 基于模拟射频计算的语义通信：当无线电计算语义之时
translated_abstract: 语义通信（SC）系统传输意义的连续潜在表示，但在资源受限的边缘设备上计算语义编码器会带来巨大的能耗与内存开销。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一种端到端的语义通信框架，利用模拟射频计算在客户端的射频接收机前端执行语义编码器。基站（BS）将编码器权重以射频波形的形式广播，而各边缘设备复用其接收机的无源混频器，以超低能耗计算语义潜在表示。这些潜在表示经上行链路传输至网络侧进行任务推理。我们证明，编码器各层的模拟计算噪声与影响所传输潜在表示的信道噪声可纳入统一的数学模型。我们定义了任务后验语义失真度量，并推导出其按客户端、按阶段语义敏感度的二阶分解。利用该分解，我们……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出让边缘设备借助模拟射频计算在射频接收前端直接执行语义编码器——由基站广播权重波形、设备复用无源混频器实现超低能耗的端到端语义通信，并建立了模拟计算噪声与信道噪声的统一数学模型及语义失真的二阶敏感度分解。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an end-to-end semantic communication framework where edge devices execute semantic encoders via analog RF computing—reusing passive mixers with encoder weights broadcast as RF waveforms by the base station for ultra-low energy consumption—and establishes a unified mathematical model of analog computing and channel noise along with a second-order decomposition of semantic distortion.
